headline: Microcap stocks lead Dalal Street returns as large, mid, and smallcaps lag
hook: Microcaps outpace large and midcaps on D-Street
summary: Microcap stocks have outperformed broader market segments, with Sigma Advanced Systems surging 595.30 per cent over the past six months. E2E Networks and Shilpa Medicare followed with gains of 216.70 per cent and 200.14 per cent, respectively. Retail investors exploring high-risk microcap segments should note the concentrated outperformance of select counters.
why_it_matters: Higher volatility expected in high-flying microcap stocks.
winners_losers: Microcap investors gain / broader market lags
